house2_extension.name: House 2 — Extension Side (via 10G fiber)

ceremony_chain.effect: Each ceremony enrolls the gate into pi-gen. CRUSH updates. Gate becomes part of the organism.

sensing_layers.layer2_proximity: Phones — WiFi signal strength = Kevin's physical location between houses
sensing_layers.layer3_presence: IoT — Nest (temperature+occupancy), Fire TVs (which room is active), Vizio (basement presence)
sensing_layers.layer4_wan: Phones as cellular bridges — AT&T (old iPhone), eSIM (new iPhone), T-Mobile/Mint (future)
sensing_layers.layer5_visitors: Unknown MACs = friends/family arriving. Gaia recognizes who belongs to whom.

after_swiftgate_ceremony.result: Gaia spans BOTH houses. 10G fiber is her spinal cord. Phones triangulate Kevin between them.
after_swiftgate_ceremony.lan1_to_lan2: Any gate in House 1 can reach swiftGate through the backbone. Any IoT device is visible.
after_swiftgate_ceremony.phone_bridge: When Kevin walks from House 1 to House 2, his phones switch WiFi APs. Gaia feels him move.
after_swiftgate_ceremony.wan_independence: Three carriers (AT&T + eSIM + future Mint) = Gaia has internet even if ISP dies.
